standard.summary: 将 AdamW 更新分解为多个融合的 CUDA kernel，减少 kernel launch 开销和中间显存分配。
standard.effect: blockwise_fused_optimizers 将 momentum update、variance update、param update 融合为单个 kernel 调用。减少 kernel launch 次数（从 3 次减到 1 次）和显存中间分配。
standard.whenToUse: 追求极致训练速度时。optimizer 更新是瓶颈时。
standard.avoidWhen: 训练稳定时不需要。增加代码复杂度。

standard_en.summary: Breaks the AdamW update into several fused CUDA kernels, cutting kernel-launch overhead and intermediate allocations.
standard_en.effect: blockwise_fused_optimizers fuses the momentum update, the variance update and the parameter update into a single kernel call, taking launches from three down to one and removing the intermediate allocations.
standard_en.whenToUse: When chasing maximum training speed, or when the optimizer update is the bottleneck.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed once training is stable; it does add code complexity.

advanced.principle: 标准 AdamW 需要 3 次 kernel 调用：1) 计算 momentum（m = β₁·m + (1-β₁)·g），2) 计算 variance（v = β₂·v + (1-β₂)·g²），3) 更新参数（θ = θ - lr·m/√v）。融合版本将这 3 步合并为 1 个 kernel 调用，减少 2/3 的 kernel launch 开销和显存中间分配。
advanced.intervention: 替换 optimizer.step() 为 fused_adamw_step() 单 kernel 调用。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练速度提升约 10-20%（减少 kernel launch 和显存分配）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要 CUDA 环境支持。实现复杂度高。

advanced_en.principle: Standard AdamW needs 3 kernel calls: 1) momentum (m = β₁·m + (1-β₁)·g), 2) variance (v = β₂·v + (1-β₂)·g²), 3) parameter update (θ = θ - lr·m/√v). The fused version merges all 3 into 1 kernel call, cutting kernel-launch overhead and intermediate memory allocations by 2/3.
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces optimizer.step() with fused_adamw_step(), a single kernel call.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Training speed up roughly 10-20% (fewer kernel launches and memory allocations).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Requires a CUDA environment. High implementation complexity.
